prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1385; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good morning. This is the adjuster with the claims department. This call is being recorded with your permission. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: Sure. I'd rather not put my full name on it, but I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Conroe?

A: I was heading through the intersection on the green light. A pickup coming from the cross street didn't stop and pulled straight into my path. I tried to brake but he hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was. The airbag on my side did deploy, though.

Q: Did you lose consciousness or hit your head?

A: No, I stayed conscious the whole time. My head didn't hit anything, but my neck snapped sideways pretty hard.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: I went to the emergency room that same afternoon. They took X-rays and diagnosed me with whiplash. I've been going to physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff, and I get headaches most days. Turning my head to check my blind spot is really hard right now.

Q: Has a doctor told you how long recovery might take?

A: They said it could be several weeks to a few months, depending on how I respond to therapy.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was following the traffic rules and I'd like this handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you about the medical records and next steps.

A: Okay, thank you.
